subject: Tufts Aquatic Center Site Plan Approval
overview: The board approved site plans and zoning relief for the new Tufts University Aquatic Center, recommended City Council approval of Main Street alterations for MassDOT safety improvements, and approved releases of covenants and site plan modifications.

items.title: Alteration of Public Way: Main Street and Mystic Avenue
items.summary: Voted 6-0 to recommend that the City Council approve the alteration of the layout of Main Street and associated temporary and permanent easements to allow MassDOT to execute a corridor safety improvement project.

items.title: Release of Covenants: Mary Kenny Way Subdivision
items.summary: Voted 6-0 to release lots 6, 7, and 8 from the subdivision covenant, retaining surety and the remaining lots to guarantee completion of infrastructure, with Director Hunt authorized to sign.

items.title: Site Plan Review: 130 College Avenue (Tufts Aquatic Center)
items.summary: Approved the site plan review and multiple zoning waivers under the Dover Amendment for the new Tufts University Aquatic Center at 130 College Avenue, subject to 24 conditions including traffic calming, a raised crosswalk, and parking management.

items.title: Zoning Amendment: Inclusionary Zoning
items.summary: Voted 6-0 to continue the public hearing on the inclusionary zoning amendment to June 17, 2026, while staff continues work on fractional payment calculations.

items.title: Site Plan Modification: 99 Revere Beach Parkway
items.summary: Approved a modification to the approved site plan to alter the garage layout, reduce parking spaces from 238 to 209 to accommodate a gas pipeline easement, and raise building height by six inches for Passive House insulation.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the draft meeting minutes for March 4, 2026, and May 6, 2026, with an amendment clarifying building height and story requirements for a Mystic Avenue project.

items.title: Administrative and Boston Avenue Zoning Updates
items.summary: Discussed scheduling, meeting format, and public outreach for upcoming Boston Avenue zoning discussions and reviewed coordination procedures with Tufts University.
